import ctypes
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_sf_airy_Ai function prototype
# double gsl_sf_airy_Ai(const double x, gsl_mode_t mode);
gsl.gsl_sf_airy_Ai.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_int]
gsl.gsl_sf_airy_Ai.restype = ctypes.c_double

# Define the mode constant
GSL_PREC_DOUBLE = 0


def compute_airy_ai(x):
    """
    Compute the Airy function Ai using GSL.

    Parameters:
    x (float): The input value at which to evaluate the Airy function Ai.

    Returns:
    float: The computed value of the Airy function Ai.
    """
    return gsl.gsl_sf_airy_Ai(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.c_int(GSL_PREC_DOUBLE))
